explain: The bug (🐛) gets hammered (🔨) — classic bug fix, not a full patch release.
Envelope opening (📬) + line going up (📈) = open rate, not click-through — no click icon here.
The branch-merge arrows (🔀) plus the frustrated face (😤) is the universal symbol for a merge conflict.
Test tube (🧪) + A vs B (🆚) is literally the icon for A/B test — split test is the marketing synonym, but A/B test is the standard term.
Fire (🔥) + siren (🚨) = something's actively broken in prod — bigger than a service degradation, that's the alert-level term.
Blocked inbox (🚫📥) means people opting out — that's unsubscribe rate, not bounce (which is a delivery failure, not a choice).
Rocket to the moon (🚀🌙) is the classic 'ship it to prod' emoji combo — deployment, not just a migration or rollback.
Water drop (💧) + email (📧) = emails dripping out over time — that's the literal meaning of drip campaign.
Lock (🔒) + key (🔑) = proving who you are to unlock access — that's authentication. Authorization is what you're allowed to do after.
Chart (📊) + bullseye (🎯) = hitting the link and clicking through — CTR. Click-to-open rate is a narrower metric (clicks ÷ opens only).
